name: Fort Zeelandia
scope: Surviving historic walls and current Anping Fort platform/watchtower; do not invent the vanished complete Dutch fortress.
era: surviving exterior represented by selected dated references

review.method: Qualla-first corpus search followed by exact named photographer Ownwork direct public-domain/CC0 originals, primary release/native bytes and current model comparison.
review.notes: The exact Taiwantaffy2010public-domain native confirms the later white observation tower with red hipped roof and dark glazed cabin, adjacent low gray-tiled arcaded hall, perforated red-brick parapet, massive raised brick platform and broad straight stair. Current whole, platform, tower, hall and stair renders retain those identifying forms. The separately mapped surviving historic wall remnants remain explicitly approximate masonry/erosion forms; this photograph does not establish their detailed condition, exact openings or restored finish. No vanished complete Dutch fortress is reconstructed. Hidden cabin/roof junctions, back elevations and exact brick/railing profiles remain medium-fi estimates. Trees/roots, visitors, temporary works, museum interiors and detached Customs House museum are excluded.

​安平古堡，原稱熱蘭遮城、安平城或臺灣城，是一座位於臺灣臺南市安平區的一個城郭遺址。於1624年由荷蘭東印度公司建立，是臺灣最早的要塞建築。自建城以來，曾是荷蘭人統治臺灣的中樞，也曾是鄭氏王朝統治者的住處。
